newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Dong-Ah in Canada resort town venture.
newsitem.headline: Dong-Ah in Canada resort town venture.

text.p: South Korea's Dong-Ah Construction Industrial Co said on Friday it had agreed with Canada's Three Sisters Resorts Inc to form a $180 million joint venture to build a resort town in Canada.
Dong-Ah will hold a 55 percent stake in the venture to build a hotel, homes, a condominium and a motel in Canmore, Alberta, over the next 72 months, a statement from Dong-Ah said.
Three Sisters will hold the remaining 45 percent stake.
Dong-Ah said a memorandum of understanding was due to be signed on Friday afternoon in Seoul, but the statement did not say when the final contract would be signed.
